plan.hypothesis: Complete legal trajectories in missing negative-X positive-Y views and actual failure-state placement recoveries improve closed-loop placement; existing approved data retained.
plan.optimizer: fresh AdamW, LoRA only, not exact resume
plan.success: Recompute first10 consecutive On+open command+actual gap>=.06m+EEF-bowl>=.10m, then50 additional policy steps retaining all gates and bowl motion<=.005m.
plan.promotion_rule: Candidate must improve paired failed-position/holding completions, preserve both positive controls across seeds, and pass both held-out positions across seeds; otherwise keep candidate experimental.
limits: Development positions that supplied teachers are not heldout generalization.
Only2 held-out positions,2 policy seeds,1 training seed; no benchmark or hardware claim.
Offline privileged teacher success is not learned policy success.
plan.evaluation_protocol_amendment: Holding-state trials require consistent OSC goals/gripper-accumulator initialization matching offline teacher; no-restore diagnostics are archived and excluded. Home trials preserve original initialization. This amendment precedes candidate evaluation.

limits: Case roles are predeclared in the plan; training-source cases and independent-position cases must be reported separately.
Small paired development study, not a benchmark success rate or unseen-position guarantee. One training seed42; policy seeds vary sampling only.
Strict success needs the first ten consecutive release gates followed by fifty policy steps maintaining the same gates and <=5mm maximum bowl drift.
Missing, invalid, exceptional or short-followup trials are not silently counted as task failures. No release at the full budget is right censored.
Completion time includes the fifty-step followup. Paired time deltas require both strict successes and identical saved initial state.
Motion uses adjacent post-observation positions. Closed/not-On/low-action runs are diagnostic proxies, not verified grasps or causes.
No model, inference, simulator or training is loaded by this summarizer.
